decisive_items: Ziehl-Neelsen staining: Positive for acid-fast bacilli
Bilateral upper-zone and mid-zone parenchymal infiltrates with nodular lesions
Large areas of necrosis rimmed by epithelioid cell granulomas with occasional Langhans' multinucleated giant cells
response.rationale: Positive AFB staining and necrotizing granulomas with pulmonary infiltrates strongly indicate tuberculosis. Sarcoidosis typically shows non-necrotizing granulomas and normal ACE, but here necrosis and AFB positivity are decisive. LGV lacks pulmonary and AFB findings.

rejected.why: Granulomas with necrosis and positive AFB are not typical of sarcoidosis; ACE normal and no non-caseating granulomas.
No genital symptoms, negative gonococcal urine, and AFB positivity point away from LGV.
